operation.description: actor-supplied, required: a core name (append or core:append) or a registered extension (ext:ns:name)

operation_version.description: actor-supplied, optional: pin an extension definition version

actor.description: actor-supplied; with a capability session_id must match it (security-sensitive)

expected_version.description: actor-supplied; required by update, supersede, resolve_proposal, close

idempotency_key.description: actor-supplied, required: request identity within the credential scope

causation_id.description: actor-supplied, optional: the operation this one responds to (validated, same resource)

correlation_id.description: actor-supplied, optional: workflow id (inherited from causation when omitted)

capability.description: actor-supplied, security-sensitive: alternative to Authorization; never stored
